info.title: web-jam-back API
info.description: The API specification of web-jam-back. Every authenticated route first runs the login check: the bearer token must be valid and name an existing user, and the user's role must pass the route's AUTH_ROLES entry when one is set; a failure there answers 401. The capability check follows. A caller whose user record carries a non-empty privileges list must hold one of the capabilities named in x-required-capabilities; a caller with an empty or absent list must have the role JaM-admin or Developer; anyone else is answered 403 and nothing is written. A caller tied to one artist (an artist slug on the account) may write only that artist's gigs, and is answered 403 otherwise.

post.summary: Announce a gig on the Josh Sherman Instagram
post.description: Converts the caption to plain text, saves the chosen image source as announceImageUrl, and publishes the public /gig/{id}/announce-image.jpg with tags and collaborators through Instagram v25.0. A failed media request with a location is retried once without it before waiting and publishing. Success sets announcedAt and appends the time and chosen image source to announcements. The image source is imageUrl, else promoImageUrl, else /gig/promo-default.jpg.

collaborators.description: Up to three public Instagram usernames without @. Omission or an empty list sends no collaborators.

locationId.description: Facebook Page ID for the Instagram location. Omission or an empty string sends no location. A rejected location is dropped on one retry.

userTags.description: Maria username first (x=0.25), venue username second (x=0.75); y=0.85. Empty strings clear a tag while preserving positions. Omitted means no tags.

200.description: The Instagram publish result, including Instagram error text on refusal.

400.description: Invalid gig id, caption, imageUrl, userTags, collaborators or locationId, or gig not found.

500.description: Instagram announce is not configured, or its key or gig could not be read, or the image source could not be saved.

post.summary: Send one pitch to a vetted venue now
post.description: Sends the email and records it. The venue must exist, not be archived, be outreach-eligible, have a valid primary email and be open to a pitch for the target weekend. The email is copied to the default addresses unless cc is given, plus the venue's secondary email when valid. The body is validated before the send permission: a caller holding only outreach:create, or an AI-agent account holding outreach:create or outreach:approve, receives 400 for an invalid body and 403 for a valid one. An AI-agent account can never send here. Requires outreach:approve, or JaM-admin or Developer when the privileges list is empty.

201.description: The email was sent; the new record.

400.description: "valid venueId is required", "targetDates is required", "targetWeekend {start, end} is required", the venue is missing, archived, not outreach-eligible or has no valid primary email, no active template exists for the type, or the template's footer photo is missing.

403.description: The caller lacks the capability, or is an AI-agent account ("AI agents may draft but never send").

409.description: The venue is not open to a pitch for this target weekend; the message gives the reason.

500.description: A lookup failed, or the email was sent and saving its record failed.

post.summary: Check a whole batch and store a dispatch record
post.description: Sends nothing. Requires a Gate 1 venue-set approval and a Gate 2 draft fingerprint approval for the batch; the venues listed must be exactly the approved venues due a pitch, and each rendered draft must match its approved fingerprint. On success the send parameters are stored under a new dispatchId for POST /outreach/batch. Give targetWeekend as an object here: the string form cannot be stored and answers 500. Requires any one of outreach:create, outreach:approve, or JaM-admin or Developer when the privileges list is empty.

200.description: The batch passed and the dispatch record is stored.

400.description: venueIds is missing, empty or holds an invalid id, targetDates or targetWeekend is missing or invalid, or venueCustomizations is invalid.

403.description: The caller lacks the capability, or "dispatch refused: ...": an approval is missing or does not match the batch, a draft cannot be rendered or does not match its fingerprint, or a footer photo is missing. Nothing is stored.

500.description: The approvals, pitch history or drafts could not be checked, or the dispatch record could not be stored.

post.summary: Send an approved batch
post.description: Two body forms. With dispatchId (from the preflight) every send parameter comes from the stored dispatch record and any other body field except actor is ignored; the call stops starting new sends after 12 seconds and reports how many venues remain, so call it again until remaining is 0. Without dispatchId the body carries the batch itself, which must pass the same Gate 1 and Gate 2 checks as the preflight, and each venue is checked and sent in turn. Requires any one of outreach:create, outreach:approve, or JaM-admin or Developer when the privileges list is empty.

200.description: The send loop ran. A venue that could not be sent is listed in skipped. A dispatch already completed answers with zero counts.

400.description: dispatchId is not a non-empty string, or, without dispatchId, venueIds, targetDates, targetWeekend or venueCustomizations is missing or invalid.

403.description: The caller lacks the capability, or "dispatch refused: ...": an approval is missing, changed or does not match, a draft cannot be rendered or does not match its fingerprint, a footer photo is missing, or the dispatch has already ended (aborted). A dispatch refused for its approvals or drafts is marked aborted and lists unsentVenues.

500.description: The dispatch record, approvals, pitch history or drafts could not be read or checked.

502.description: Dispatch form only: the mail account or connection failed on the first venue of this call, so nothing was handled. The dispatch can be called again.

get.description: Read-only. Returns venues that are outreach-eligible, not archived, have a valid primary email, have no future resumeBooking date, are not booked through the start of the target window, are open to a pitch for it and have no gig within their gig interval (two months when unset). Without a readable targetDates the window is today and the response is a plain array. Bracketed query names such as targetWeekend[start] are not read. Requires any one of outreach:create, outreach:edit, outreach:delete, outreach:approve, or JaM-admin or Developer when the privileges list is empty.

parameters.description: Sending this without targetDates answers 400; its value is never used as the weekend.

parameters.description: Batch id or weekend key; matched against either stored field.

get.description: Requires any one of outreach:create, outreach:edit, outreach:delete, outreach:approve, or JaM-admin or Developer when the privileges list is empty.

400.description: "batchId parameter is required".

404.description: No Gate 2 draft fingerprint approval for the batch.

parameters.name: batchId
parameters.description: Batch id or weekend key; matched against either stored field.

get.summary: Read both approvals for a batch
get.description: Requires any one of outreach:create, outreach:edit, outreach:delete, outreach:approve, or JaM-admin or Developer when the privileges list is empty.

200.description: Both gates; a gate with no record is null.

400.description: "batchId parameter is required" (blank value).

404.description: Neither approval exists for the batch.

parameters.description: Outreach record id.

400.description: "Find id is invalid" or "nothing found with id provided".

put.description: Only status, gmailThreadId and actor are read. A status other than sent clears nextTouchDue. No outcome is stamped; use POST /outreach/{id}/outcome for that. Requires outreach:edit, or JaM-admin or Developer when the privileges list is empty.

400.description: "Update id is invalid", "status not valid" or "Id Not Found".

delete.description: Requires outreach:delete, or JaM-admin or Developer when the privileges list is empty.

400.description: "Delete id is invalid" or "Id Not Found".

post.summary: Start a database backup
post.description: Developer role only; the AUTH_ROLES setting is not read. Answers at once; the export and upload to Dropbox run afterwards, and old runs are pruned after a good run. Unlike POST /admin/backup/runs, the answer does not name the run.

409.description: "backup run in progress": a backup or restore is active.

500.description: "Dropbox backup settings absent". The caller's account could not be read also answers 500.

get.description: Developer role only; the AUTH_ROLES setting is not read. A Mermaid diagram generated from the record definitions.

500.description: The diagram could not be generated. The caller's account could not be read also answers 500.

get.description: Developer role only; the AUTH_ROLES setting is not read. The Mermaid system map kept in the repository.

500.description: "failed to read system map". The caller's account could not be read also answers 500.

get.description: Developer role only; the AUTH_ROLES setting is not read. Dated runs are listed newest first.

500.description: "Dropbox backup settings absent", or Dropbox could not be read. The caller's account could not be read also answers 500.

post.summary: Start a database backup and name its run
post.description: Developer role only; the AUTH_ROLES setting is not read. Answers at once; follow the run at GET /admin/backup/operations/{name}.

409.description: "backup run in progress": a backup or restore is active.

500.description: "Dropbox backup settings absent". The caller's account could not be read also answers 500.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Backup run name. A value containing "..", a slash or a backslash is refused.

post.summary: Restore the production database from a run
post.description: Developer role only; the AUTH_ROLES setting is not read. Answers at once; the remaining checks and the restore run afterwards. A refusal or failure is reported as a failed operation at GET /admin/backup/operations/{name}.

202.description: "restore started"; the name is the restore operation's.

400.description: "a valid run name is required" or "the run's date, typed as YYYY-MM-DD, is required".

409.description: "a backup or restore is in progress".

500.description: "Dropbox backup settings absent" or "the database connection is not available". The caller's account could not be read also answers 500. A request body that cannot be parsed also answers 500.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Backup run name. A value containing "..", a slash or a backslash is refused.

post.summary: Copy a run into the DEV database
post.description: Developer role only; the AUTH_ROLES setting is not read. Email addresses are replaced in the copy. Answers at once; the copy runs afterwards and its result or refusal is reported at GET /admin/backup/operations/{name}.

202.description: "copy to DEV started"; the name is the copy operation's.

400.description: "a valid run name is required".

409.description: "a copy to DEV is in progress".

500.description: "Dropbox backup settings absent", or the DEV database setting is refused. The caller's account could not be read also answers 500.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Operation name. A value containing "..", a slash or a backslash is refused.

get.summary: Read the state of a backup, restore or copy
get.description: Developer role only; the AUTH_ROLES setting is not read. Operations are held in memory. For a name not held, the manifest of the backup run with that name is read from Dropbox and answered as a backup operation.

400.description: "invalid operation name".

404.description: No operation or run manifest has this name.

500.description: The manifest could not be read from Dropbox. The caller's account could not be read also answers 500.

get.description: Answers from the result of the server's last scheduled check.

200.description: The newest good run and whether the last run failed.

500.description: The check has not run yet, or it could not tell the state of the backups.

get.description: The cache is refreshed hourly.

parameters.name: pageId
parameters.description: Facebook page id; defaults to the configured default page.

200.description: The cached posts; empty with a null lastUpdated when nothing is cached for the page.

put.description: Requires a role listed in AUTH_ROLES.facebook. Exchanges a short-lived Facebook user token for the page's token, stores it and refreshes the page's cache.

200.description: The token was stored. lastUpdated is null when nothing is cached for the page.

400.description: "userToken is required", or the exchange or the storing of the token failed.

500.description: A request body that cannot be parsed also answers 500.

post.summary: Submit a contact or booking form
post.description: Emails the submission to the artist's booking contact. Limited to 5 submissions per hour from one client address. A submission without a known form value or an allowed Origin header, with a value in website, or filled in less than 3 seconds by formLoadedAt, is answered 200 and not sent. The booking forms jam-bookus and tim-booking also require the contact and event fields and have the venue address checked, and their message wording can cause the same unsent 200.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Sent by the browser; needed for the submission to be emailed.

200.description: "email sent". Also the answer to a submission that was not sent.

400.description: A booking form lacks a required field or has an invalid one, or its venue address could not be verified.

429.description: "Too many requests, please try again later."

500.description: The request could not be handled. A request body that cannot be parsed also answers 500.

get.summary: Read the current or latest livestream
get.description: The channel's live video, else its latest completed one. A successful lookup is cached for 15 minutes.

200.description: The video; status none with a null videoId when there is none, the lookup is not configured or it failed.

post.summary: Email a gig promotion to subscribers
post.description: Sends to every active subscriber with the email channel on, one at a time, adding each one's unsubscribe link. Requires promo:email, or JaM-admin or Developer when the privileges list is empty.

200.description: Counts of the sends; a failed recipient is counted and does not stop the rest.

400.description: "subject and bodyHtml are required".

403.description: "missing promo:email capability" or "not authorized to send promo email".

500.description: The caller or the subscriber list could not be read. A request body that cannot be parsed also answers 500.

post.summary: Sign up for gig updates
post.description: Stores a pending subscriber and emails a confirmation link. An address that is already active is left unchanged; a pending or unsubscribed one is made pending again.

200.description: "Almost there — check your email to confirm your subscription" or "You are already subscribed".

400.description: "Name is required" or "A valid email is required".

500.description: Storage failed, or the confirmation email could not be sent after the pending record was stored. A request body that cannot be parsed also answers 500.

get.description: Makes the subscriber active and clears the confirmation token.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token from the emailed link, given once.

400.description: An HTML page: "Invalid confirmation link" (no token).

404.description: An HTML page: "This confirmation link is no longer valid" (unknown token).

500.description: Storage failed.

get.description: Marks the subscriber unsubscribed.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The token from the emailed link, given once.

400.description: An HTML page: "Invalid unsubscribe link" (no token).

404.description: An HTML page: "This unsubscribe link is no longer valid" (unknown token).

500.description: Storage failed.

get.description: Requires a role listed in AUTH_ROLES.admin. Every query parameter is used as a filter on the subscriber field of that name.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only subscribers with this status.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Only the subscriber with this stored address.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Only subscribers with this name.

500.description: Storage failed, for example on a filter value of the wrong type.

post.summary: Add a subscriber
post.description: Requires a role listed in AUTH_ROLES.admin. The status defaults to active. An unsubscribe token is generated.

400.description: "Name is required", "A valid email is required" or "status not valid".

500.description: Storage failed, for example because the email address is already stored. A request body that cannot be parsed also answers 500.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Subscriber id.

500.description: Storage failed. A request body that cannot be parsed also answers 500.

bearerAuth.description: A web-jam-back login token. Browser logins expire after 24 hours; agent service tokens do not expire.

OutreachUnauthorized.description: No valid token, no user for it, or the user's role is not allowed on this route. These routes also answer 401, with the error's message, when handling the request fails unexpectedly, for example on a body field of the wrong type.

OutreachForbidden.description: The caller lacks the capability ("missing ... capability"), or has no privileges list and is not JaM-admin or Developer ("not authorized for outreach").

NotLoggedIn.description: No valid token, no user for it, or the user's role is not allowed on this route.

Forbidden.description: The caller lacks the capability (for example "missing gig:edit/tour:edit capability"), has no privileges list and is not JaM-admin or Developer, or is tied to a different artist ("not authorized for this artist").

ActionUnauthorized.description: No valid token, no user for it, or the user's role is not allowed on this route. The route also answers 401, with the error's message, when handling the request fails unexpectedly, for example on a body field of the wrong type.

TopAdminUnauthorized.description: No Authorization header, an invalid token, no account for it, or an account whose role is not Developer. This route does not answer 403.

id.description: The published post's id, when ok.

error.description: Why the publish failed, when not ok.

locationDropped.description: The first media request's error when the post was successfully published after retrying without its requested location.

artist.description: Artist slug; records without one belong to jammusic.

announcements.description: Successful Instagram posts, appended in order. Absent on gigs without recorded history.

imageUrl.description: The chosen image source, not the public JPEG route.

title.description: Required when songId is not set

familyNearby.description: A boolean sets a manual override; null or an empty string restores derivation.

Song.description: Authenticated catalog record; rights remain optional until independently verified, for the applicable song category. No recording or URL is required.

artist.description: Artist slug for artist-scoped admins. Absent for super-admins and ordinary users.

photoData.description: Image data URL, or an empty string to clear the photo reference.

sweptAt.description: Parseable date, normalized to UTC midnight.

actor.description: Recorded as lastModifiedBy; defaults to the caller's user id.

bookedDate.description: A readable date; required when status is booked.

dismiss.description: Mark reviewed without writing the venue.

reopen.description: Return the record to sent; takes precedence over the other fields.

customBody.description: Inserted at the template's custom body marker.

targetDates.description: Date text placed in the email.

items.description: Venue name, or its id when names cannot be read.

lastPitchDate.description: Latest pitch for the target weekend.

dispatchedCount.description: Stored as 0 when not a number.
